title: Arch Linux Dotfiles
summary: A clean, procedural system configuration for Arch Linux using Cosmic and Hyprland, styled with Catppuccin.
description: This repository manages a complete Linux environment with a focus on strict file hygiene and XDG directory compliance. Configurations are organised under .config/ rather than the home root.
The setup includes custom Zsh scripts and environment variables using full descriptive English to ensure readability and maintainability across updates.

title: Next.js Portfolio with Payload CMS
summary: A modern, accessible portfolio built with a focus on performance and clean procedural TypeScript.
description: Built as a central hub for my engineering work, this project integrates Payload CMS with a Next.js frontend to allow for dynamic project tracking and task management.
The architecture follows a strict procedural pattern, avoiding shorthand to ensure the codebase remains accessible and easy to reason about.

title: Procedural TypeScript Toolkit
summary: A boilerplate and utility collection for developers who prefer explicit, readable, and procedural TypeScript code.
description: This toolkit provides a set of patterns and configurations that enforce full-word variable naming and avoid the 'shorthand trap' common in modern React ecosystems.
It leverages ts-reset to improve TypeScript's built-in types and provides a clear roadmap for building readable enterprise-grade applications.
